heading.en: A pond is a working machine

hook.en: A village kere looks still, but sunlight, water, algae, fish and microbes are all working together in it. That working unit of living and non-living parts is an ecosystem.
hook.kn: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕೆರೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಲವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕು, ನೀರು, ಪಾಚಿ, ಮೀನು ಮತ್ತು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಜೀವಿಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿವೆ. ಜೀವಂತ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಜೀವ ಘಟಕಗಳ ಈ ಕಾರ್ಯಘಟಕವೇ ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ.

objectives.en: Define an ecosystem and classify ecosystems
Describe the components of a pond ecosystem

narration.en: A village kere looks still, but sunlight, water, algae, fish and microbes are all working together in it. That working unit of living and non-living parts is an ecosystem.
narration.kn: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕೆರೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಲವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕು, ನೀರು, ಪಾಚಿ, ಮೀನು ಮತ್ತು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಜೀವಿಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿವೆ. ಜೀವಂತ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಜೀವ ಘಟಕಗಳ ಈ ಕಾರ್ಯಘಟಕವೇ ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ.

body.en: An ecosystem is a functional unit of nature, where living organisms interact among themselves and also with the surrounding physical environment. Ecosystems vary greatly in size, from a small pond to a large forest or a sea. The entire biosphere can be seen as a global ecosystem, a composite of all the local ecosystems on Earth; because it is too large and complex to study at once, it is divided into two basic categories, terrestrial and aquatic. Forest, grassland and desert are terrestrial ecosystems; pond, lake, wetland, river and estuary are aquatic ecosystems. Crop fields and an aquarium are man-made ecosystems.

points.en: Aquatic: pond, lake, wetland, river, estuary

narration.en: An ecosystem is a functional unit of nature in which organisms interact with each other and with their physical surroundings. Forests, grasslands and deserts are terrestrial; ponds, lakes, rivers and estuaries are aquatic; crop fields and aquaria are man-made.
narration.kn: ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಜೀವಿಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಮತ್ತು ಭೌತಿಕ ಪರಿಸರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಿಯಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಘಟಕ. ಅರಣ್ಯ, ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಾವಲು, ಮರುಭೂಮಿ ಭೂಪರಿಸರ; ಕೊಳ, ಸರೋವರ, ನದಿ, ನದೀಮುಖ ಜಲಪರಿಸರ; ಬೆಳೆಯ ಹೊಲ, ಅಕ್ವೇರಿಯಂ ಮಾನವನಿರ್ಮಿತ.

title.en: Structure: species composition, stratification and the pond

body.en: Interaction of biotic and abiotic components results in a physical structure characteristic of each ecosystem. Identification and enumeration of the plant and animal species gives the species composition. Vertical distribution of different species occupying different levels is called stratification: in a forest, trees occupy the top vertical stratum or layer, shrubs the second, and herbs and grasses the bottom layers. The components work as a unit through four functional aspects: productivity, decomposition, energy flow and nutrient cycling. A pond is a shallow water body that shows all these basic components well. The abiotic component is the water with dissolved inorganic and organic substances and the rich soil deposit at the bottom; solar input, the cycle of temperature, day-length and other climatic conditions regulate the whole pond. The autotrophic components are the phytoplankton, some algae and the floating, submerged and marginal plants at the edges. The consumers are zooplankton and the free-swimming and bottom-dwelling forms. The decomposers are fungi, bacteria and flagellates, especially abundant at the bottom.

points.en: Stratification: trees (top) → shrubs → herbs and grasses (bottom)
Four functions: productivity, decomposition, energy flow, nutrient cycling
Pond autotrophs: phytoplankton, algae, floating, submerged, marginal plants
Pond consumers: zooplankton, free-swimming and bottom-dwelling forms

narration.en: Each ecosystem has a structure: its species composition and stratification, with trees on top, shrubs below and herbs and grasses at the bottom of a forest. A pond shows all the parts clearly: water and mud, phytoplankton and plants, zooplankton and fish, and decomposers at the bottom.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ರಚನೆ ಇದೆ: ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ತರೀಕರಣ; ಅರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಮರಗಳು, ಕೆಳಗೆ ಪೊದೆಗಳು, ತಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಲಿಕೆ-ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಳು. ಕೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು-ಕೆಸರು, ಸಸ್ಯಪ್ಲವಕ-ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು, ಪ್ರಾಣಿಪ್ಲವಕ-ಮೀನುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ತಳದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಘಟಕಗಳು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: Classify each organism of a pond into its component: (a) Hydrilla, (b) zooplankton, (c) bacteria in the mud, (d) lotus at the edge, (e) a fish.

steps.en: Autotrophs (producers) make food by photosynthesis: Hydrilla (submerged) and lotus (marginal/floating).
Consumers eat other organisms: zooplankton and fish.
Decomposers break down dead matter: bacteria in the mud.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Classify each organism of a pond into its component: (a) Hydrilla, (b) zooplankton, (c) bacteria in the mud, (d) lotus at the edge, (e) a fish.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the NEET and KCET pattern.

points.en: An ecosystem is a functional unit of organisms and their physical environment.
points.kn: ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಜೀವಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಭೌತಿಕ ಪರಿಸರದ ಕಾರ್ಯಘಟಕ.

points.en: Ecosystems are terrestrial, aquatic or man-made.
points.kn: ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಭೂ, ಜಲ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾನವನಿರ್ಮಿತ.

points.en: Functions: productivity, decomposition, energy flow and nutrient cycling.
points.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು: ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ, ವಿಘಟನೆ, ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶ ಚಕ್ರ.

homework.en: Visit a nearby pond or tank and list two organisms of each component.

narration.en: Recap. An ecosystem is a functional unit of organisms and their physical environment. Ecosystems are terrestrial, aquatic or man-made. Structure: species composition and stratification. Functions: productivity, decomposition, energy flow and nutrient cycling.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಜೀವಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಭೌತಿಕ ಪರಿಸರದ ಕಾರ್ಯಘಟಕ. ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಭೂ, ಜಲ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾನವನಿರ್ಮಿತ. ರಚನೆ: ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ತರೀಕರಣ. ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು: ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ, ವಿಘಟನೆ, ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶ ಚಕ್ರ.
